body:
### Research answers

#### 1. Published CAM references and G-code standards

- **Autodesk Fusion Manufacture Help (`MFG-TOOL-ORIENTATION-OVERVIEW`)**: The Setup WCS Z axis sets the spindle approach direction. Operations inherit `Setup WCS orientation` as the default tool direction. The operator clamps the physical workpiece to match that WCS.
- **LinuxCNC G-code coordinate documentation (`linuxcnc.org/docs/html/gcode/coordinates.html`)**: `G54` through `G59.3` store origin offsets. `G10 L2 P<n> R<angle>` rotates only the XY plane about Z. RS-274 and ISO 6983 work offsets cannot tilt a 3-axis spindle.
- **Conclusion**: A tilted Setup WCS requires the CAM kernel to transform coordinates into the WCS frame before posting. Without that transform, only `Part alignment` (`crates/app/src/setup_align.rs`) turns the part relative to the machine Z axis.

#### 2. Option 1: where a user can tilt a milling WCS today

- **WCS page (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_page.rs`)**: `origin_fields` draws `Tilt about X (roll)` and `Tilt about Y (pitch)` on every machine. `quarter_turns` draws `Turn X+`, `Turn X-`, `Turn Y+`, and `Turn Y-` on every machine, including `Kind::Mill`. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_page_tests.rs` checks that all six turn buttons stay live.
- **Feature WCS picker (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_pick_row.rs`)**: The Setup page (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_settings_page.rs`) hosts `Set WCS from features`. That control runs `align_roles` and queues `SetWcs` with no `Kind::Mill` tilt guard.
- **MCP surface (`crates/app/src/mcp/wcs_tools.rs`)**: `set_wcs_from_features` executes `SetWcsOrigin` with no `Kind::Mill` tilt guard.
- **Generation refusal (`crates/app/src/setup_wcs_tilt.rs`)**: `collect_job` (`crates/app/src/operation/job.rs`) calls `generation_problem` at generation time. `selection_geometry_in` (`crates/app/src/operation/selection.rs`) calls `setup_problem` on a non-level facing pick. The user sees no warning when setting the WCS.
- **Related UI PRs**: Issue `#1648` (`in-review`) moves the work-offset selector to the WCS page. Issue `#1720` (`in-review`, part 1 of `#1649`) adds `Flip X`, `Flip Y`, and `Flip Z` under Quarter turns with a generation and post refusal.
- **Current `Part alignment` coverage (`crates/app/src/setup_align.rs`)**: `verified_kind` allows `Face`, `Contour`, `Pocket`, `Adaptive2D`, `Pocket3D`, and `Finish3D` on `Kind::Mill`. `generation_problem` still refuses other operation kinds, operation tilts, and 2D area controls until their own verification lands (`#326` and `#763`).

#### 3. Option 2: why WCS-as-tool-direction is `effort:max` and overlaps `#760` and `#763`

- **5-axis RTCP vs 3-axis WCS output**: `OpFrame` (`crates/app/src/operation/frame.rs`) composes `part_alignment` and `TiltedFrame`. `TiltedFrame::world_path` stamps a tilted tool vector onto moves. Posts like `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` emit `G43.4` RTCP blocks for tilted records. Three-axis posts like `assets/posts/carvera.cps` refuse tilted records via `tiltOk`. A flipped 3-axis setup needs plain 3-axis XYZ coordinates in the WCS frame, not 5-axis tool vectors.
- **`OpFrame` gaps (`crates/app/src/operation/frame.rs`, `crates/app/src/operation/job.rs`)**: `OpFrame` implements `height_z_local`, yet `collect_job` still calls `opframe.resolve_heights` in setup S space. `collect_job` also refuses `SrcRef::Selection` picks whenever `TiltedFrame` exists.
- **`Tilt` field coverage (`crates/app/src/operation/types/params.rs`)**: `OpParams::tilt` exists on 10 planar 2D kinds (`Face`, `Contour`, `Pocket`, `Adaptive2D`, `Offset2D`, `Engrave`, `Chamfer2D`, `Circular`, `Slot`, `Trace`). `Drill`, `Pocket3D`, `Finish3D`, `TrochoidalSlot`, and `Deburr` carry no `Tilt` field.
- **Post rotation refusal (`crates/app/src/posting_wcs_rotation.rs`)**: `rotated_wcs_problems` refuses any offset rotation above `ROT_TOL_RAD = 1e-9`. The post stream writes `OriginX/Y/Z` translation only.
- **Stock simulation (`crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs`)**: `plan_program` refuses posed rotary and tilted moves (`POSED_REFUSAL`). Multi-setup stock carry currently uses `Part alignment`, not rotated work offsets.
- **Issue overlap**: Issue `#760` (`P6`, `effort:max`) already covers end-to-end rotated offset carry. Issue `#763` (`in-review`, Phase 1) plans to evaluate `#760` in Phase 4 after `OpFrame` settles.

---

### Design proposal

**Recommendation**: Pick **Option 1** now. Keep `Part alignment` (`crates/app/src/setup_align.rs`) as the single part-turning workflow for milling setups. Let `#763` and `#760` address rotated offsets separately. Option 1 fixes the user surprise in one small UI change. It preserves every `#1518` safety gate.

#### Option 1 — Smallest useful first slice (Slice 1)

1. Check `machine::kind_of_setup` on the WCS page (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_page.rs`).
2. Keep `Turn Z+` and `Turn Z-` live on `Kind::Mill`.
3. Disable `Tilt about X (roll)`, `Tilt about Y (pitch)`, `Turn X+`, `Turn X-`, `Turn Y+`, and `Turn Y-` on `Kind::Mill`, or show a warning banner whenever WCS Z tilts off machine Z.
4. Show a short message next to those controls that points the user to `Part alignment` on the Setup page (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_settings_page.rs`).
5. Update `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_page_tests.rs` to test the `Kind::Mill` guard while non-mill machines keep X and Y turns live.
6. Keep `crates/app/src/setup_wcs_tilt.rs` (`#1518`) unchanged so generation still blocks old files and MCP tilted setups.

#### Option 1 — Follow-on slice (Slice 2)

1. Update `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_pick_row.rs` (`Set WCS from features`) so a tilted `Kind::Mill` fit warns before generation or converts the rotation to `AlignPartToSetup` (`crates/app/src/commands/setup_align.rs`).
2. Add matching `Kind::Mill` warning or conversion handling in `crates/app/src/mcp/wcs_tools.rs` (`set_wcs_from_features`).

#### Option 2 — Alternative slices (only if the maintainer chooses Option 2)

Option 2 replaces `#760` and `#763` Phase 4 for milling setups. Keep `crates/app/src/setup_wcs_tilt.rs` (`#1518`) active until all four slices pass:

1. **Frame and heights**: Extend `OpFrame` (`crates/app/src/operation/frame.rs`) for setup WCS frames. Switch `collect_job` heights to `height_z_local`.
2. **Generators and picks**: Route 2D, 3D, `Drill`, and picked selections through the WCS frame. Keep output as upright 3-axis coordinates with no stamped 5-axis vectors on 3-axis posts.
3. **Stock and dexel simulation**: Evaluate stock bounds, dexel checks (`crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs`), and cross-setup stock carry in the WCS frame.
4. **Post and gate removal**: Transform posted coordinates into the rotated WCS frame (or control cycle where configured). Align with `#1649` axis flips. Replace `crates/app/src/setup_wcs_tilt.rs` refusals once end-to-end tests pass.

---

### Proposed sub-issues (not filed — waiting for maintainer choice)

#### Option 1 sub-issues (recommended)

1. **Title**: `WCS page: guide milling setups to Part alignment instead of X/Y WCS tilt`
   - **What it does**: Guards X and Y WCS tilt controls on `Kind::Mill` setups in `wcs_page.rs` and directs the user to Setup `Part alignment`.
   - **Done means:** Structural tests in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_page_tests.rs` pass for `Kind::Mill` and non-mill machines, and `setup_wcs_tilt` keeps blocking tilted milling generation.
   - **Proposed labels**: `P4`, `effort:medium`, `area:ui`

2. **Title**: `WCS feature pick and MCP: warn or convert to Part alignment when milling WCS tilts off Z`
   - **What it does**: Adds a `Kind::Mill` tilt warning or `AlignPartToSetup` conversion to `wcs_pick_row.rs` and `mcp/wcs_tools.rs` (`set_wcs_from_features`).
   - **Done means:** UI and MCP tests verify the milling warning or conversion path, and no tilted milling WCS slips past without notice.
   - **Proposed labels**: `P6`, `effort:medium`, `area:ui`, `area:mcp`

#### Option 2 sub-issues (only if the maintainer picks Option 2)

1. **Title**: `OpFrame: resolve local heights (height_z_local) and geometry in the setup WCS frame`
   - **What it does**: Extends `OpFrame` to apply setup WCS rotation and wires `height_z_local` into `collect_job`.
   - **Done means:** Unit tests pin bounds and height calculation on tilted setup WCS frames, un-tilted golden files stay identical, and `setup_wcs_tilt` keeps blocking generation.
   - **Proposed labels**: `P6`, `effort:high`, `area:multiaxis`

2. **Title**: `3-axis generators and picks: machine in setup WCS frame without stamped 5-axis vectors`
   - **What it does**: Routes 2D, 3D, `Drill`, and picked-selection generators through the setup WCS frame as 3-axis moves.
   - **Done means:** Numeric toolpath tests pass for planar, 3D, drill, and feature-pick operations on tilted WCS setups without triggering `G43.4` RTCP, and `setup_wcs_tilt` keeps blocking generation.
   - **Proposed labels**: `P6`, `effort:max`, `area:3d`

3. **Title**: `Stock simulation and carry: evaluate and carry stock in a tilted setup WCS frame`
   - **What it does**: Evaluates setup stock bounds, dexel gouge checks, and multi-setup stock carry in the setup WCS frame.
   - **Done means:** Dexel verification and rest-material carry tests pass on flipped and arbitrarily tilted setup WCS frames, and `setup_wcs_tilt` keeps blocking generation.
   - **Proposed labels**: `P6`, `effort:max`, `area:3d`

4. **Title**: `Post and WCS gate: emit rotated setup WCS coordinates and lift #1518 refusal`
   - **What it does**: Transforms posted G-code into the setup WCS frame (matching `#1649` flips) and removes the `#1518` refusal in `setup_wcs_tilt.rs`.
   - **Done means:** End-to-end golden NC tests match hand-computed programs for a flipped milling WCS, and `wcs_tilt.rs` tests validate the full workflow instead of refusal.
   - **Proposed labels**: `P6`, `effort:max`, `area:post`
